title: Big Buck Bunny (2008)
creator: Blender Foundation

preprocessing.color_input: Decoded Theora planar YUV420P; consume luma, no RGB/BGR conversion
preprocessing.range: Interpret source Y as limited [16,235], output full [0,255]; explicit tv to pc
preprocessing.range_formula: clip(floor((Y-16)*255/219 + 0.5),0,255); scale/range conversion fused by libswscale
preprocessing.rounding: Pinned FFmpeg/libswscale integer filtering and quantization; no Python/OpenCV gray conversion
preprocessing.authority: Exact exported .bin SHA-256 is authoritative; same bytes for Golden and PC input

transform: Select frames; Lanczos resize to 960x540; FFmpeg gray uint8 full-range luma; no audio
decode_note: The original OGG reports a keyframe-flag warning. Frames are decoded sequentially from the beginning (no keyframe seek); archive CRC and source/input hashes are verified.
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers
notice: These frames are a sampled prerecorded sequence, not a 30fps throughput test.
